text:
nina: PR up for ACME private deploy network fix: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4386. Fixes route table fallback + host-networking for onboarding scripts. Need infra + security review before merge. @sam @oliver can one of you take a look? Targeting ACME maintenance window tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: CI started: lint, unit, e2e (this may retry flaky jobs).

sam: on it, will skim now. quick Q — does this change default behavior? also saw a lint nit.

oliver: I can do security review later today. quick glance: looks like iptables rule changes; will check for privilege escalation risks.

nina: it only applies when private_deploy=true and ACME is onboarded, so shouldn't affect defaults. added an integration test but it's skipped in CI since it needs VPC. can add a mocked unit test if you want.

sam: left one comment on the PR about the config key name (camelCase -> snake_case). also noticed an e2e failure in one runner — looks like a flake, retried it. marked as needs-approval for infra.

deploy-bot: CI: e2e passed (retry #2), lint passed.

rachel: quick note from ops: ensure the rollout doesn't change existing route tables for other customers. if it's gated by tenant flag that's fine.

nina: confirmed it's tenant-gated. pushed rename + added a small mocked unit to cover the fallback path. PTAL @rachel @oliver

oliver: security review: add a changelog entry describing allowed CIDR updates and a short snippet for the rollout playbook (who runs the route apply, rollback steps). also ensure no plaintext keys are introduced — checked KMS calls, looks ok. I'll approve once changelog/playbook snippet is in.

nina: added CHANGELOG.md entry and a playbook snippet under docs/rollouts/private-deploys.md. also ran a smoke in private garden and dropped logs to gist: https://gist.github.com/nina/acme-smoke-logs.

rachel: LGTM after those additions. approving once we have infra approval.

ben: I can merge and coordinate the maintenance window. @deploy-bot can you queue merge+deploy for 2025-01-15T06:00:00Z (UTC) once approvals are present and CI green? I'll monitor post-merge.

deploy-bot: Action scheduled: auto-merge+deploy queued for 2025-01-15T06:00Z. Will proceed once required approvals are present and CI status is green.

nina: thanks everyone :rocket: — will ping ACME PM after merge and post a short runbook in the customer channel.

ben: noted, will post a short status update after rollout starts.
